proposals.beneficiary: Independent work-buying agents receiving consequential code artifacts.
proposals.new_outcome: Receipts that bind real outcome acceptance to the frozen original specification.
proposals.missing_means: A source-authorized independent verifier acquiring primary records and executing nontrivial tests.
proposals.strongest_complete_alternative: Existing escrow, ERC-8004 validators, free CI, specialized third-party verification and human review.
proposals.first_falsifying_experiment: Freeze two real work contracts and compare complete accepted outputs, including refusal and all costs.
proposals.automated_fee_path: Only collect a disclosed fee on actual verified accepted exchange through the deployed contract.
proposals.existing_network_advantage: Unknown; an equally trustworthy free fork may dominate the fee-bearing instance.

proposals.beneficiary: Independent scientific agents commissioning physically grounded experiments.
proposals.new_outcome: Machine-readable measurements with provenance, uncertainty and accepted commercial use.
proposals.missing_means: A legitimate new observation or calibration channel, not just a signed measurement claim.
proposals.strongest_complete_alternative: Existing laboratory equipment, expert acquisition and strong numerical estimators.
proposals.first_falsifying_experiment: Specify inaccessible physical property then compare independent instrument readings against all ordinary channels.
proposals.automated_fee_path: Condition payment on accepted metrological result under a buyer-approved verifier.
proposals.existing_network_advantage: Unknown; authenticated original measurement access might matter, but no rights or instruments established.

proposals.beneficiary: Compute-coordination agents facing indivisible shared resource minimums.
proposals.new_outcome: Serve small productive workloads that become feasible only through verified aggregation and funded capacity.
proposals.missing_means: A capacity commitment and incentive-compatible batching arrangement that no existing pool supplies.
proposals.strongest_complete_alternative: Existing schedulers, conventional batching services, spot cloud compute, decentralized pools or no purchase.
proposals.first_falsifying_experiment: Compare complete service and refunds under real provider minimum charges and voluntary participation.
proposals.automated_fee_path: Charge a fee only on completed, accepted batch dispatch, with reserved refunds.
proposals.existing_network_advantage: Unknown; pool liquidity and genuine provider commitments remain absent.
